admission.justification: The member boundaries together protect the end-to-end promise: a concern alone cannot constrain writes or remediation, and a slot guard alone cannot preserve request/report identity and primary-chat ownership.

guarantee: One supplied concern may be investigated across source/task/memory/report/log evidence with checks only in scratch or repository tooling sandbox. Its named report returns to the supplied parent role/task reporting address, which may resolve a replacement occupant, before any explicitly ordered system remediation. Actual starter remains concern and question provenance; no order gives code, memory, task or role-start authority.
title: One scoped investigation produces a report without acquiring leaf mutation authority
